cases.sentence: Собирайся, народ бесстыжий, пока не исполнилось определенное ___.
cases.explain: The passive sense 'determined by the Lord' requires the instrumental case to indicate the agent.
The preposition на (on) with the prepositional case indicates location on the earth.

cases.sentence: Будет покинута Газа, и Ашкелон руинами ___.
cases.explain: The future tense ляжет (will lie) agrees with the future action described in the verse.

cases.sentence: Станет пастбищем ваше побережье с пастушьими хижинами и загонами для ___.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case to show what the folds are for.

cases.sentence: Я услышал брань Моава и насмешки ___.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the noun 'insults of' to show possession.

cases.sentence: С Моавом будет то же, что и с Содомом, с Аммонитским народом, что и с ___.
cases.explain: The instrumental case with 'as' shows comparison or similarity.

cases.sentence: Оставшиеся из моего народа разграбят их и унаследуют их ___.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb унаследуют (will inherit) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Страшен будет для них Господь, когда истребит всех богов ___.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: 'gods of the land.'

reading.ru: Собирайся! Собирайся, народ бесстыжий, пока не исполнилось определенное Господом.
reading.question: What is the people urged to do?
options: Gather together before the appointed time
reading.correct: Gather together before the appointed time
reading.explain: The verse urges 'Gather yourselves together, you nation that has no shame, before the appointed time.'

reading.ru: Ищите Господа, все смиренные на земле, творящие Его волю.
reading.question: Who should seek the Lord?
options: All the humble of the earth who do His will
reading.correct: All the humble of the earth who do His will
reading.explain: The text says 'Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances.'

reading.ru: Будет покинута Газа, и Ашкелон руинами ляжет.
reading.question: What will happen to Gaza and Ashkelon?
options: They will be forsaken and become desolate
They will be crowned as capitals
reading.correct: They will be forsaken and become desolate
reading.explain: The verse says 'Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon will be a desolation.'

reading.ru: Я услышал брань Моава и насмешки аммонитян.
reading.question: What has the Lord heard from Moab and Ammon?
options: Reproaches and insults against His people
reading.correct: Reproaches and insults against His people
reading.explain: The text states 'I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon.'

reading.ru: Поэтому верно, как и то, что я живу, возвещает Господь сил.
reading.question: How certain is the Lord's judgment?
options: As certain as the fact that He lives
reading.correct: As certain as the fact that He lives
reading.explain: The Lord swears 'As I live, says Yahweh of Armies, surely Moab will be as Sodom.'

reading.ru: Вот что они получат за свою кичливость, за то, что издевались и заносились над народом Господа сил.
reading.question: Why will Moab and Ammon be punished?
options: For their pride and mocking God's people
reading.correct: For their pride and mocking God's people
reading.explain: They will be punished 'for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh.'
